declaration.scientific_question: Can a frozen B0 produce useful hindsight helper labels for unspecialized FineMath TRAIN continuations?

teacher.fixed_initial_text:
Write one short helper note that explains concepts or relationships useful for continuing the passage. You may inspect the observed continuation to create this training label. Do not quote or copy the continuation verbatim. Give only a one-line helper note, without a final-answer field, extra examples, or another Passage.

Passage:
The metal spoon was left in a pot of soup on the stove. After several minutes, Lea lifted it by the handle.
Observed continuation:
 The handle felt hot because heat had traveled through the metal.
Helper note: Metal conducts heat from the hot soup toward the part held by the person.

Passage:
The town council posted the revised rules in the community hall. Some residents had not seen the announcement.
Observed continuation:
 A second notice was sent to every household.
Helper note: A posted message can miss people who do not visit the hall, motivating wider communication.

Passage:
The report compares how quickly two search procedures examine a large set of records. It first counts the work done by the simpler procedure.
Observed continuation:
 Its running time grows in proportion to the number of records.
Helper note: Examining each record once gives a linear relationship between input size and total work.
